name: @repo/social-hover-card
description: A profile hover card: avatar/handle trigger that expands into a preview with stats, bio and a follow action.

useCases: Author or mentioner preview card on hover in a feed or comment thread
Team directory with quick-view profile popovers
Mention chips that expand into a rich profile preview
compositionHints: Use with inline-testimonials to preview the author behind a quote
Pair with animated-avatar-group for a stack that opens individual previews
